ios.desc:
Sensor Logger collects, records and displays data from a range of sensors on iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad and AirPods — including accelerometer, gyroscope, GPS, audio, camera and Bluetooth devices. You can log device properties such as screen brightness, battery and network state. Select and preview desired sensors in a few taps. A single tap initiates the recording function, which works even when the app is in the background. View and manage recordings within the app via interactive plots. The app supports many export formats, including Zipped CSV, JSON, Excel, KML and more. For advanced use cases, stream data via HTTP or MQTT, resample measurements from multiple sensors, create Studies to collect data from other users systematically and write custom automation rules based on sensor, time and location. Once you have collected your data, you can create Stories — data-driven dashboard with your recordings, hosted online for effortless sharing.

Sensor Logger is designed for researchers, educators, and anyone interested in collecting or monitoring sensors on their smartphone. It serves as the ultimate toolbox for exploring various fields, including physics, science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).

- One-tap logging
- Background recording
- Recordings on interactive plots
- Stream data via HTTP & MQTT
- Intelligent, custom rule engine
- Zipped CSV, JSON, Excel, KML & SQLite exports
- Resample and aggregate measurements
- Enable & disable specific sensors
- Scan and log nearby Bluetooth devices
- Add timestamp-synchronised annotations during recording
- Adjust sampling frequency for sensor groups
- Custom recording workflow
- Raw and calibrated measurements available
- Live plots and readings for sensors
- Organise, sort and filter recordings
- Control & track recording session from Watch
- Bulk export & delete recordings
- Resources to help you analyse your data
- Data stays on-device and private
- Create and share dashboard-style, data-driven Stories using your recordings, hosted online. 

Studies & Sensor Logger Cloud

Create Studies to collect data from other Sensor Logger users efficiently. When activated, Studies use the investigator's specified sensor configuration for consistent data collection. Participants can upload their recordings to a secure cloud and join, pause, or switch Studies anytime.
